title: Semantics of a Halted Configuration
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine with oracle, input $x$, and configuration guard $G$. For any register valuation $v$ and Boolean answer $b$, the configuration with no live state, valuation $v$, and stored answer $b$ is terminating under $G$ and accepts exactly when $b$ is true.
